subject.why: Lantern, vine, and mossy stone base match the requested brief clearly.

category.why: Missing a horizontal ground plane or tabletop; the base floats in the backdrop.

clean.why: Free of UI elements, text, logos, or characters.

framing.why: Centered with balanced padding on all sides.

colour.why: Monochromatic palette lacks separation between the brass lantern and orange backdrop.

detail.why: Volumes are clean without distracting surface micro-details.

style.why: Chunky 3D shapes and satin finish align with reference art.

fix: Place the stone on a distinct ground surface and change the background hue to improve silhouette separation.
